papers.title: Decoupled Predictive Decision Making: A Shared Conditional Predictor for Agents
papers.summary: DPDM improves agent decision accuracy by combining frozen language-model representations with a shared pretrained conditional predictor that learns from deployment evidence without parameter updates.
papers.summary_zh: DPDM结合冻结语言模型表示与共享条件预测器，无需更新参数即可从部署证据中学习，提升智能体决策准确率。

papers.title: SplatAnything: Gaussian Spacing Normalization for Feed-forward 3DGS across Arbitrary Scenes
papers.summary: SplatAnything applies Gaussian Spacing Normalization to canonicalize scene-level Gaussian spacing, yielding more consistent supervision and improved feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting under varying scene scales and viewpoints.
papers.summary_zh: 提出高斯间距归一化方法，统一场景级高斯间距，提升前馈3D高斯泼溅在不同尺度与视角场景下的效果。

papers.title: P^2-MOPD: Accelerating Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation via Parameter Priors
papers.summary: P^2-MOPD jointly optimizes mixing coefficients and student weights under an on-policy distillation objective, enabling faster and more balanced recovery than MOPD by treating experts as parameter priors while keeping the student trainable.
papers.summary_zh: P^2-MOPD将专家模型视为参数先验，联合优化混合系数与学生权重，比MOPD更快、更均衡地完成在线蒸馏。

papers.title: TailSteer: Trajectory-Tail Steering for Drift-Resistant Multi-turn Image Editing
papers.summary: TailSteer is a final-stage training framework that reduces cumulative visual drift in multi-turn image editing by applying on-policy denoising corrections near the trajectory tail while preserving pretrained generative and editing abilities.
papers.summary_zh: TailSteer在轨迹尾部施加去噪修正，抑制多轮图像编辑的累积视觉漂移，且保留预训练的生成与编辑能力。

papers.title: LowRAM: Low-Rank Keys and Amortised Values for Composable KV Cache Compression at Test-Time
papers.summary: A method compresses KV caches by predicting values from keys within each attention head and applying cross-layer low-rank key compression, enabling higher decoding throughput and composability with quantization and eviction.
papers.summary_zh: LowRAM用键预测值并跨层低秩压缩键来压缩KV缓存，提升解码吞吐，且可与量化、淘汰方法组合使用。

papers.title: PCBRouteAgent: How Close Are LLM Agents to Becoming PCB Routing Engineers?
papers.summary: Automating printed circuit board (PCB) routing requires coordinating board-level connectivity decisions with geometric execution under strict design rules. Although recent agents can interact with native routing tools, reliable routing on complex boards remains challenging. We present PCBRouteAgent,
papers.summary_zh: 评估LLM智能体能否胜任PCB布线工程师，指出复杂板上可靠布线仍具挑战，并提出PCBRouteAgent智能体。

papers.title: LongBanana: An Expert-Verified Benchmark for Long-Context Multi-Reference Image Synthesis
papers.summary: LongBanana is an expert-verified benchmark and agent-harness framework for evaluating and improving long-context multi-reference image synthesis through graph-grounded checklists and an RPR workflow.
papers.summary_zh: LongBanana是经专家验证的基准与智能体框架，通过图结构清单和RPR流程评测并提升长上下文多参考图像合成能力。

papers.title: The Last Mile to the Real World: Agent-Native Primitives as Reusable Building Blocks for Solving Real-World Tasks
papers.summary: A harness engineering framework composes reusable LLM-equipped primitives into task-specific graphs, verifies and revises them, and improves agent success on real-world tasks while reducing time and cost.
papers.summary_zh: 将可复用LLM原语组合为任务图并验证修订，提升智能体完成真实任务的成功率，同时降低时间与成本。

papers.title: Confucius4-R2T2: A Stable-Prefix Streaming ASR Model for Real Real-Time Transcription
papers.summary: A full-context speech recognizer is adapted to emit immutable streaming transcripts with near full-context accuracy and low latency by learning longest stable prefix labels.
papers.summary_zh: 将全上下文语音识别模型改造为输出不可变流式转录的模型，学习最长稳定前缀标签，实现接近全上下文精度的低延迟识别。

papers.title: LLMs Don't Know What They Know: Benchmarking Temporal Self-Knowledge for Financial Backtesting
papers.summary: A benchmark of dated U.S. financial facts shows that large language models often understate their knowledge and that common safeguards cannot reliably certify that historical backtests are free of information leakage.
papers.summary_zh: 构建美国金融事实的时间自知识基准，发现LLM常低估自身知识，且常见防护手段无法可靠排除回测中的信息泄露。

papers.title: Beneath the Surface: What We Overlook When We Talk About Agent Evolution
papers.summary: Agent harness evolution can improve benchmark performance without weight updates, but gains are unreliable, costly, and transfer inconsistently, motivating preservation-aware evaluation and EvoAudit revisions.
papers.summary_zh: 指出智能体harness演进收益不稳定、成本高且迁移不一致，提出保持性评估及EvoAudit修订方法。

papers.title: Fast and Exact Relative-Position Attention via Structure-Aware Kernels
papers.summary: An exact tiled attention algorithm integrates additive relative-position terms into FlashAttention-style computation, reducing memory and compute overhead and accelerating long-context relative-position transformers.
papers.summary_zh: 提出一种精确的分块注意力算法，将相对位置项融入FlashAttention式计算，降低开销并加速长上下文Transformer。

papers.title: EvoWorld: Towards Out-of-Sight World Evolution in Generative Video Models
papers.summary: EvoWorld combines a vision-language model that maintains and reasons over world state with a segment-autoregressive video renderer to improve event-conditioned causal evolution and revisit consistency in generative video world simulators.
papers.summary_zh: EvoWorld结合视觉语言模型与分段自回归渲染器，提升生成视频世界模拟器中的事件因果演化与重访一致性。

papers.title: Video-Coder: Reinforcing Agentic Coding for Video Generation
papers.summary: Video-Coder is a code-driven video generation agent that writes and executes code to build structured 3D draft videos, then uses supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning with execution and video rewards to improve controllable video generation.
papers.summary_zh: Video-Coder让智能体编写代码构建3D草稿视频，并通过监督微调与执行、视频奖励强化学习提升可控视频生成。

papers.title: On the Opportunities and Challenges of Prefill-to-Autoregressive Cross-Model Transfer
papers.summary: PLatour is an open-source prefill-to-autoregressive cross-model transfer framework that links frozen language models through lightweight trainable bridges, while PACT-Check measures how much of its gains come from genuine sender-receiver communication rather than adaptation or spurious signals.
papers.summary_zh: PLatour通过轻量可训练桥接连接冻结语言模型以实现跨模型迁移，PACT-Check则检验增益是否来自真实通信。

papers.title: Muir: Linear Attention with Sensitivity-Allocated Gating and Matched-Filter Readout
papers.summary: A linear attention architecture called Muir allocates gate capacity by sensitivity, uses matched-filter readout and a stable parallel update, improving language modeling, long-context recall, and training speed over Gated DeltaNet-2 and Transformer baselines.
papers.summary_zh: Muir线性注意力按敏感度分配门控容量并用匹配滤波读出，语言建模与长上下文召回优于部分基线模型。

papers.title: AgentBaton: Efficient Model Collaboration in Agentic Tasks
papers.summary: A lightweight detector enables cost-effective collaboration between capable and efficient language models in long-horizon agentic tasks by learning when to hand off control, reducing API costs while preserving or improving accuracy.
papers.summary_zh: AgentBaton用轻量检测器学习何时移交控制，实现强弱模型在长程智能体任务中的低成本协作，降低API费用并保持精度。

papers.title: Terminal-style Mathematical Modeling Bench: The First Agentic and Verifiable Benchmark for Mathematical Modeling
papers.summary: TB-MathModel is a terminal benchmark that makes complete contest-style mathematical modeling problems agentic and verifiable, scoring final numeric answers against multiple human references with feasibility checks.
papers.summary_zh: TB-MathModel将竞赛级数学建模题做成可验证的终端智能体基准，以多份人工参考答案及可行性检查评分。

papers.title: SwarmEvolve: Latent Agent Swarms for Evolutionary Discovery and Optimization
papers.summary: LLM-guided evolutionary search uses AI agents to improve programs for mathematical and computational problems by iteratively refining solutions and combining high-scoring methods. papers.summary_zh: SwarmEvolve用潜在智能体群做LLM引导的进化搜索改进程序，缓解每轮长文本思维链造成的效率低下。

papers.title: Exploring Weight-Space Programming: Capabilities, Generalization, and Limitations
papers.summary: Weight-Space Programming can produce large localized accuracy gains and uneven cross-task transfer, but reliable editing remains inconsistent.
papers.summary_zh: 研究权重空间编程的能力与局限，发现其可带来局部化的大幅精度提升，但跨任务迁移不均，编辑可靠性也不稳定。
